flags.text: Part of this ranch's supply arrived on GTAs the ledger refused, so its later sales were short. Treat as exposure, not fraud.

flags.text: Following every GTA upstream (mass-balance tracing), 28% of the animals this ranch received originate on ranches with post-2020 clearing, embargoes, Indigenous-land overlap or impossible births.
